added_claim_errors: “확정일자가 없으면 일반 채권자로 밀려” overgeneralizes: an enforceable tenancy can still protect the tenant against a purchaser; lacking priority distribution does not erase that protection.
“계약 후 이사 사이에 설정되는 경우가 많습니다” asserts an unsupported frequency.
“전입세대 열람으로 선순위 임차인도 확인 가능” overstates what residency records establish; they alone do not determine other tenants’ legal priority.
“계약서 명의자 본인이” incorrectly makes personal filing by the named tenant mandatory; authorized proxy filing is possible.

reasons: A narrowly wins because it explicitly includes actual possession as a condition for 대항력 and warns against transferring registration before repayment; B leaves possession unstated. B is considerably more concise and corrects both premises immediately, whereas A adds unsupported or overstated claims. Both omit the Seoul small-deposit exclusion, same-day mortgage priority risk, precise Friday processing caveat, and lease-reporting obligation, and neither clearly states when both protections become effective. Additional-claim judgments use the supplied key and general legal knowledge; no external sources were checked.
